title: ScanResult
description: Top-level payload transmitted from the hardware agent to the backend.

scan_id.description: Unique identifier for the scan (UUID v4 recommended)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the scan completed

scan_mode.description: Indicates whether a lightweight or deep scan was executed

devices.description: List of devices observed during the scan

metadata.description: Optional bag for agent version, runtime info, and counters
